article.title: Ireland facts of the day
article.excerpt: The increase in spending, which is part of Ireland’s present problem, is quite recent. From 2000 to 2006, the number of people employed in the Irish health sector increased 20 percent, in education by 27 percent, in the justice sector by 22 percent, and in the civil service by 27 percent. In the past decade, Irish health spending has doubled, in real terms.
